description: This file defines the 'Patient' data model class used in the healthcare frontend app. It includes properties such as id, name, email, age, and phone, along with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and copying.

classes.name: Patient
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a patient with basic demographic details, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization and copying.

methods.name: Patient.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Patient instance from a JSON map, extracting fields like id, name, email, age, and phone.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the Patient instance into a JSON-serializable map.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Returns a new Patient instance with specified properties overridden.
